info.name: Traveler's Guide to Elysia
info.description: Contractor eldritch invocations for Aurora Builder.
info.author: Michael

p.em: Prerequisite: Pact of the Contractor feature

description.p: Once per Contract, you may extend the time you have to fulfill its Clause by 1 round.
If the Contract is not fulfilled, you and one creature of your choice within 5 feet of you both suffer the Contract’s breach effect.

sheet.description: Once per Contract, you may extend the time you have to fulfill its Clause by 1 round. If the Contract is not fulfilled, you and one creature of your choice within 5 feet of you both suffer the Contract’s breach effect.

p.em: Prerequisite: Pact of the Contractor feature

description.p: When a creature makes a saving throw against an effect you caused, you may use your reaction to impose a penalty equal to half your Charisma modifier (rounded down) on the roll.
You may use this feature twice per short or long rest.

sheet.description: When a creature makes a saving throw against an effect you caused, impose a penalty equal to half your Charisma modifier (rounded down) on the roll.
